title: fix(core): blorb zzz flarp
body:
## Summary
Increase MAX_BATCH_SIZE from 50 to 100 in src/batch.py and add boundary tests that accept 100 items and reject 101.

## Rationale
The import worker supplies up to 100 items per page; the current limit rejects valid pages and forces an unnecessary split.

## Testing
Validation plan: run tests/test_batch.py for the 100-item boundary and the rejected 101-item case.

## Limitations
No memory or throughput measurements have been taken; larger accepted batches may increase peak memory.

## Breaking changes
None expected; batches previously accepted remain accepted.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/batch.py b/src/batch.py
--- a/src/batch.py
+++ b/src/batch.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 50
+MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 100
 
 def accepts(items):
     return len(items) <= MAX_BATCH_SIZE

diff --git a/tests/test_batch.py b/tests/test_batch.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_batch.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from src.batch import accepts
+
+
+def test_boundary():
+    assert accepts([0] * 100)
+    assert not accepts([0] * 101)
